meetings.heading: 3 p.m., Monday, November 16
meetings.program: Senate will resume consideration of the nomination of Daniel Desmond Domenico, of Colorado, to be United States Circuit Judge for the Tenth Circuit, and vote on confirmation thereon at 5:30 p.m. Following disposition of the nomination of Daniel Desmond Domenico, Senate will vote on the motion to invoke cloture on Thune (for Capito) Amendment No. 6883 to H.R. 2347, Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act (legislative vehicle for the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act).
